text:
Hannah Lee: Noticing elevated error rate for llama-lite-q on runtime-3.5.2 in us-central after the kernel selector change. Error is a 503 from the model binder when resolving quant profile; only affects tenants with dynamic aliasing. Proposing a short tenant-scoped runtime pin while we patch the binder.
Rajiv K.: Can you paste an error sample and affected tenants?
Hannah Lee: Samples and tenants below (window 07:10-07:22 UTC):
```
2026-06-12T07:15:03Z tenant=delta-ops req=aa11bb status=503 binder=alias_resolve error="quant_profile_not_found for alias=llama-lite-q:latest"
```
Rajiv K.: Ok. I'd rather do tenant-scoped runtime pin to runtime-3.4.9 which still has the old binder behavior. That avoids a global rollback. Add TTL 2h and a 1% canary on other tenants.
Hannah Lee: Agreed. I'll open a 2.5h change window and notify SRE.
deploybot: Proposed: `/pin runtime runtime-3.4.9 scope=tenants:delta-ops,epsilon-labs models=llama-lite-q reason="binder-quant-profile-missing-after-3.5.2" ttl=7200 canary=1% initiated_by=@Hannah Lee`
eng-oncall-bot: Change window opened 07:30-10:00 UTC. Notifying eng-runtime on-call.
SRE Pager: Suppressing noisy binder alerts for pinned tenants; high-sev channel remains. PagerDuty on-call paged.
deploybot: Pin applied: PIN-11045 scope=tenants:[delta-ops,epsilon-labs] runtime=3.4.9 models=[llama-lite-q] ttl=7200s canary=1% initiated_by=Hannah Lee. To extend: `/deploybot extend PIN-11045 hours=1`
Rajiv K.: I'll work on a small binder patch to tolerate missing quant-profile metadata and fallback to default quant profile. ETA ~3h. Will post PR when ready.
Hannah Lee: Can changelog-bot draft a short customer note for CS? "Tenant-scoped runtime pin (PIN-11045) for delta-ops and epsilon-labs due to binder quant-profile mismatch after runtime-3.5.2."
changelog-bot: Draft created: https://git.redwood/release-notes/pins/11045/draft. Please review.
SRE Pager: I'll post telemetry snapshots (error counts, p95 latency) every 10m in this thread during the window. If errors drop below threshold for 30m we can unpin early.
Hannah Lee: Thanks. If the patch passes canary we will remove PIN-11045 and promote runtime-3.5.2 for those tenants. Keep this thread for telemetry and unpin decision.
